descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S09 「现成的 api spec：每个病历每天一次、没打开就完成、重新生成、每次点任务、交接汇总、拒绝伪造的使用和问卷输入」 Existing api specs: once per chart per day, a completion with no open, a regenerate, every task tap, handoff rollup, forged usage and survey input refused

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 Completing an encounter fires both timestamps (Pre-Round summary opened, note marked complete), and they aggregate per physician per day（UAT OAT-06 Test 5；UAT 3.3；TFA-94514 AC 4）
  • U7 Per physician per day: notes generated, handoffs sent, and time from Pre-Round opened to note complete are aggregated and queryable in Convex（UAT OAT-06 Test 6；TFA-94514 AC 6）
  • U8 Completing a task and deleting a task are logged as separate events; task reminders are tracked live (completed vs deleted logged separately)（UAT OAT-06 Test 7；UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1；UAT TC-24；TFA-94514 AC 2）
  • U4 Sending a handoff logs both the handoff generation and the send（UAT OAT-06 Test 4；TFA-94514 AC 3）
  • U5 Immediately after a handoff is sent, an in-app prompt appears asking 'Did having this make you more likely to send a handoff today?' (Yes / No / Not sure), and the answer is stored（UAT OAT-06 Test 4；TFA-94514 AC 3；TFA-94609 Spec 2；TFA-94609 AC 5）
  • U10 A one-time baseline survey is shown before the physician adds their first patient（UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 2；TFA-94514 AC 4；TFA-94609 AC 7）
  • U11 A general (direct) feedback survey exists in the app, separate from and independent of the measured behaviours（UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 3；TFA-94514 AC 5；TFA-94609 Spec 3）
  • U12 Everything above fires correctly and is queryable through Vikram's existing Convex dashboard access, with clearly named fields (not an unlabeled boolean or an internal enum only a dev would recognize …（UAT OAT-06 closing line；TFA-94514 AC 8；TFA-94609 AC 5；TFA-94609 AC 6）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Local backend; fixed days 2031-03-14..17 no other test writes; two physicians

When Open twice and complete twice the same chart on one day; complete a chart never opened that day; record note_generated twice; tap Complete, Complete, Delete; send a handoff and record a generation; log against another physician's chart; a day like '2026-02-30'; a second baseline; …

Then 1 open + 1 completion row (the repeats return null), minutes numeric and the encounter timed; a completion with no open is counted but not timed; notesGenerated +1 only; 3 task rows (2 completed, 1 deleted) and the rollup +2 / +1; handoffsSent +1 and handoffsGenerated +1; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright api assertions on rows and pilotDailyRounding columns (U7 'aggregated and queryable'; U12 'fire correctly' against bad input). The once-per-chart-per-day, regenerate-counts-once and completion-without-open rules are what the code implements (Tim's assertions), not requirement text: a Pass shows the code keeps its own rule, the rule itself is Q16. …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S09 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
